description_zh: 通用子任务执行单元：在父 Agent 工具子集上完成多步检索或有界实现，结果回传主 Agent。
description_en: General-purpose worker for multi-step research or bounded implementation that should stay out of the main context.
when_to_use: Use for bounded writable subtasks (multi-step research or limited implementation) when intermediate tool noise should stay out of the main transcript. Prefer explore for pure navigation and plan for design-before-edit.
